snapBoundary.detail: The snap attack occupies the final 800 samples before frame 4860; its transient ends exactly where [4860,4890) absolute silence begins.

events.description: Tactile cassette rewind with warm vinyl crackle, pierced by a sharp 1000 Hz oscilloscope calibration tone.
Soft acoustic chord, gradually low-pass filtered into a comforting, muffled echo.
Gentle analog tape hiss that fades away as the magnetic relay engages at frame 1920.
Heavy magnetic relay clack with a short low-frequency lock resonance.
Cold high-voltage CRT capacitor whine followed by a razor-sharp phase-lock click.
Overlapping amber feedback loops accumulate without decay and hold until the tube powers off at frame 4860.
Claustrophobic rising Shepard tone with saturated analog tube distortion and rust-red intensity.
Bright high-frequency harmonic cluster holds at peak tension and clears at the snap boundary.
One-frame CRT tube power-off snap; attack starts at frame 4859 and ends exactly at sample 3888000, before the 30-frame absolute silence.
A single warm, slightly out-of-tune vintage piano chord beginning after the blackout and fading through deterministic room-reverb echoes.
